text:
ola (Hiring Manager): New hire starting Monday (Ravi). Need a tiny, paste-ready onboarding blurb for the welcome email plus a manager "first-7" checklist and a compact 30/60/90. Keep it very short — one paragraph + bullets. Also a clear one-line "who to ping" for common blockers.
maria (People Ops): I got you. Will keep this email-friendly and copy/paste ready. Any special infra access?
ola (Hiring Manager): Repo + staging read, analytics dashboard, no GPUs. Would like buddy pairing and a small starter ticket by day 3.
maria (People Ops): Cool. Draft below — feel free to edit before sending.

- Welcome blurb (single paragraph you can paste):
  "Welcome to Redwood! Your first week will focus on accounts, quick product orientation, meeting your team, and completing a small starter task to get hands-on with the codebase. We’ll deliver your laptop and accounts before your first day, and you’ll have a buddy for pairing. Expect short check-ins with your manager on Day 1 and at the end of the week; deliverable: open a tiny PR and a 3-line note on what you learned by Friday."

- One-page first-7 manager checklist (copy/paste bullets):
  - Day -1: confirm device & shipping, pre-provision SSO, add to Slack + calendar, assign buddy.
  - Day 1: 09:30 People Ops intro, 11:00 manager 1:1 (role + immediate priorities), 14:00 buddy lunch, 16:00 join standup + set 7-day goal.
  - Day 2: 10:00 product/arch walkthrough, 14:00 repo tour + local dev setup, assign starter ticket (<= 4h).
  - Day 3: pair on starter ticket, quick review, give actionable feedback.
  - Day 4: cross-team intros (ops, infra, product), security checklist, continue starter.
  - Day 5: EOW demo (10-15m), 30m feedback + 30/60/90 touchpoints, set 30-day milestones.
  - Week 2 prep: plan follow-up tasks, identify first measurable impact area.

- Compact 30/60/90 for manager email (3 bullets each):
  - 30d: complete onboarding flows, ship starter PR, finish security & docs training, attend weekly demo.
  - 60d: own a small bug/feature end-to-end, participate in cross-team planning, begin owning a metric.
  - 90d: lead delivery of a minor feature, shorten review cycles for own work, propose one improvement that reduces friction.

kevin (IT): For device/account automation: Ill image and queue a MacBook Air to SF desk. Adding groups: eng, repo-read, analytics-view. Imaging ETA Mon 07:30 PT. CLI (in case you want to reprovision):
```
rwctl provision --user ravi.k --groups eng,repo-read,analytics-view --device mac-air
```
kevin (IT): Please DM shipping address if desk pickup needed.
sasha (Security): Note: no infra creds until 2FA enabled. Ill run a 10-min security primer Tue 15:00. KMS/HSM and staging write access require a short approval ticket + manager sign-off. Docs: <https://security.redwood/onboard>.
maria (People Ops): Onboard-bot will send the new-hire packet with links and tasks (I-9, payroll, SSO). Make sure paperwork is done Day 0 to avoid delays.
onboard-bot: New-hire packet created for ravi.k. Tasks: I-9, payroll, SSO invite. Due: 2026-05-01 23:59 PT.
ola (Hiring Manager): Nice. One-liner "who to ping" I can paste:
  Who to ping: IT (device/accounts) - @kevin; Security (2FA/creds) - @sasha; People Ops (payroll/benefits) - @maria; Buddy/Team questions - assigned by manager.
maria (People Ops): Ill also drop a 1-page manager mini-guide (give feedback first 2 weeks, set small wins, check on comfort with tooling) into the new-hire profile and add the Fri EOW check to the calendar. :sparkles:
ola (Hiring Manager): Thanks everyone. Ill paste this into Ravi's welcome email and send. If you need Ravi's personal email for shipping DM me. :thumbsup:
